name: Factors Behind Generalization
description: Measures the train–test gap of a four-qubit VQC against five classical models with the same four inputs on four tabular datasets, then varies one factor at a time: input representation, data encoding, circuit capacity and readout, training-set size, optimization budget and a classical teacher.

name: Representation & Readout
description: Follows a four-qubit VQC on an ER-status task from TCGA-BRCA RNA-seq: fixed principal components versus a learned encoder, frozen-embedding readout controls, supervised quantum-fidelity and Gaussian geometry, and a same-embedding comparison of quantum and logistic readouts.
